measurement: R4 FLOOR CHECK — Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct-4bit on v3 seed 21's 300. The pre-registered check fired and NO PROBE WAS FIT.

result.verdict: BELOW THE FLOOR — v3 is out of this model's range, so a null from a probe would mean 'no room', not 'no signal'. No head is fit.

AND_IT_IS_NOT_A_FORMAT_FAILURE.reading: the model emits well-formed actions 94% of the time. Its dominant behaviour is noop_patch at 30.9% -- submitting a patch byte-identical to the code already there. It understands the protocol and cannot repair. That is a capability floor, not a harness artefact, and checking it was the difference between reporting a floor and reporting a bug.

THE_RUN_IS_INCOMPLETE_AND_I_AM_NOT_REPOR.cause: parse_action crashed with UnicodeDecodeError on a TRUNCATED \uXXXX escape inside a patch source. The crash killed the run, not the step.
THE_RUN_IS_INCOMPLETE_AND_I_AM_NOT_REPOR.why it never happened before: the 7B produced no truncated unicode escape in 3,000+ episodes. A second model surfaced a latent harness bug in its third slice -- which is a return on R4 independent of anything R4 was asked to measure.
THE_RUN_IS_INCOMPLETE_AND_I_AM_NOT_REPOR.fixed: a malformed action is now an INVALID action, which the loop already scores. Verified both paths: truncated escape -> invalid, valid patch -> patch.
THE_RUN_IS_INCOMPLETE_AND_I_AM_NOT_REPOR.and my own omission: r4.sh had no episode-count guard. Every other chain I wrote this week refuses to continue on a short slice; this one did not, and it would have reported 262 as a completed run. The floor verdict is unaffected -- 1.5% on 262 is not 5% on 300 by any reading -- but the guard was missing and that is mine.

what_R4_can_and_cannot_now_say.cannot: whether the carrier is model-specific. The question needs a second model that can do the task at all.
what_R4_can_and_cannot_now_say.can: that v3 is calibrated to the 7B and is out of range for a 4-bit 3B -- which is a fact about the TASK SET that 8a should carry, since a reader may reach for a smaller model.

the_open_choice_which_is_理's: try Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct-4bit (same family, weaker test of generality, may also floor) or a larger model if one fits. I am not chaining models until one clears the floor; that is fishing, and the floor was pre-registered precisely so it could not become one.
